name: Robe of Stars
description: A deep blue robe embroidered with six white stars that shine.
body:
## What it does

While you wear it, every saving throw you make is a little better. As an action you can pull a star from it and cast magic missile at 5th level; the star is gone until dusk, when 1d6 of the missing stars return. You can also step bodily into the Astral Plane and back.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.note: each star pulled is one charge

features.name: Astral
features.text: As an action, enter the Astral Plane with everything you carry, until you return.
